title: A combinatorial large sieve for Sidon sets, distances, and norm forms
summary: We develop a new combinatorial large sieve method for sets with bounded algebraic multiplicities. The method exploits algebraic splitting modulo many small primes: local congruence branching produces many modular collisions, while global bounded-multiplicity hypotheses force these collisions to be rare. As a first application, we prove that every Sidon subset $A\subset\{1^2,\ldots,N^2\}$ satisfies \[ |A| \le N\exp\left( -c\frac{\log N}{\log\log N} \right) \] for some absolute constant $c>0$.
